ruleset.name: Claude Code Java quality gates
ruleset.description: High-signal hygiene rules; enable build failure after the initial baseline is cleaned. String literal comparisons and nullable String receivers must use Apache Commons Lang Strings.CS/CI.equals, Strings.CS/CI.startsWith/endsWith, and Strings.CS/CI.contains so comparison direction, case sensitivity, and null handling stay explicit. CharSequence emptiness checks must use isEmpty() instead of comparing length() with zero. Locale-sensitive case conversion must name its locale, boolean values must use Boolean.toString() instead of string-valued true/false conditionals, and critical file-permission results must not be discarded.

rule.name: LiteralStringEquality
rule.message: Use Strings.CS.equals for case-sensitive or Strings.CI.equals for case-insensitive comparison

rule.name: ReverseStringEquality
rule.message: Use Strings.CS.equals or Strings.CI.equals with the nullable receiver as the second argument

property.name: xpath

rule.name: StringPrefixSuffixEquality
rule.message: Use Strings.CS/CI.startsWith or Strings.CS/CI.endsWith for String prefix and suffix checks

rule.name: StringContainsEquality
rule.message: Use Strings.CS.contains or Strings.CI.contains for String substring checks

rule.name: UseStringUtilsIsBlank
rule.message: Use StringUtils.isBlank/isNotBlank instead of String#isBlank so null receivers are handled explicitly

rule.name: UseStringUtilsIsEmpty
rule.message: Absorb the null check into StringUtils.isEmpty/isNotEmpty instead of combining a null comparison with String#isEmpty

property.name: xpath

rule.name: UseJsonNodeIsEmpty
rule.message: Use JsonNode#isEmpty() (or its negation) instead of comparing JsonNode#size() with zero

property.name: xpath

rule.name: LocaleSensitiveCaseConversion
rule.message: Specify a locale for case conversion (normally Locale.ROOT for protocol, identifier, and lookup normalization)

rule.name: UseCharSequenceIsEmpty
rule.message: Use isEmpty() instead of comparing a CharSequence length with zero

property.name: xpath

rule.name: UseBooleanToString
rule.message: Use Boolean.toString(boolean) instead of a conditional returning "true" or "false"

rule.name: IgnoredFilePermissionResult
rule.message: Do not ignore the result of a file-permission change; check it or document why failure is harmless

rule.name: NoPrintStackTrace
rule.message: Use the project logger instead of writing a stack trace to the process stderr

rule.name: LambdaToStaticMethodReference
rule.message: Replace lambda p -> Type.method(p) with a static method reference Type::method

property.name: xpath
